description: The sandbox face (machine_face.rs): the app's own copy of the editor, which the workspace window shows when app.intentic.dev cannot be reached, on this computer's own sandboxes. Local content only: no `remote` is set, so the hosted editor the same window shows the rest of the time is granted nothing here, and its one channel into the app stays the intentic:// navigation. The page may ask for this computer's sandboxes with a session the machine minted for each one's owner (the token goes to the page, which talks to that sandbox's daemon on its loopback port with it), for a fresh one when a daemon refused it, and whether the online workspace answers again (asked by the offline page too, offline.html, which is the same window's local content: a no-cors fetch it would otherwise use cannot tell a dead platform's 530 from the workspace). Named by WEBVIEW: the workspace is a webview in the app's one window beside the main window (frame.rs), and naming the window would grant these to the main window's page too.
